claims: No uniform finite-start trajectory protocol distinguishes zero from fixed positive volume entropy over the unrestricted smooth divergence-free class, even with the nowhere-zero requirement and common measurement noise.
Adaptive chosen-start transcript TV is at most m/M; with an energy cap B, the nowhere-zero family gives Omega(B/eta) starts for fixed eta and gadget constants.
For iid uniform-volume starts the same nowhere-zero family gives Omega(B/eta^2); if zeros are permitted, the immutable compact-support family gives Omega(B/eta^2) for chosen starts.
peer_exposure: Read frozen c08_s01-s03 and available c08_l01-l03,l05-l07,l09-l10 after CROSS_PHASE; c08_l04 had no frozen INITIAL and was not audited.

remaining_gaps: Independent proof audit and historical priority review.
